questions: Does oval steering_oscillation fall below 0.25 from 0.291 with the held geometry, and what kd or kp did you use?
Does the score stay at or above 213.28? If it falls, is the controller the cause, given that the geometry is held?
Does s-bend max_error stay near 0.063 m, which would confirm that track width alone cannot reach the 0.06 m floor?
Do slalom and s-bend line_loss_events stay at or below 1.25 per run?
feedback_request.requested_changes_if_any: If oval steering_oscillation is still above 0.25 with the held geometry, report the controller change you made (kd or kp) so I can judge whether geometry is the limit. If the score is at or above 213 and s-bend max_error is still above 0.06 m with oscillation below 0.25, I may propose wheel_track 0.08 m in a later iteration, but only with kp lowered to match. If the score falls below 213, report the controller settings so I can separate controller from geometry effects.

intent: Hold the iteration 7 geometry exactly (wheel_track 0.09 m, five 12 mm sensors at x = -0.024 to +0.024 m and y = 0.04 m, wheel radius 0.03 m, body 0.12 x 0.18 m, mass 0.6 kg) so that the race isolates the Integrator's controller change. Expected result: a score at or above 213, oval steering_oscillation below about 0.25, and s-bend and slalom line-loss events at or below 1.25 per run. No geometry change this iteration, so the 213.28 baseline remains the comparison.
learning: Iteration 7 confirms that lowering kp to 3.5 at the 0.09 m track raised the score from 153 to 213 and reduced slalom line loss from 2 to 1. Track-width gains have flattened on the s-bend, and the oval now shows oscillation above 0.25. The next gains are most likely from controller damping at this geometry, not from further geometry changes. Read this race against the iteration 7 baseline of 213.28 on the oval, s-bend and slalom.
rationale: Iteration 7 (kp 3.5 at wheel_track 0.09 m, otherwise unchanged) scored 213.28, up from 153.01, so the controller change is the main gain. The oval finished 4 of 20 runs (up from 2), with progress 0.82. Slalom line loss fell from 2.0 to 1.0. The remaining problems are oval steering_oscillation of 0.291 (above the 0.25 caution level), s-bend max_error of 0.0643 m (still above the 0.06 m off-track floor), and s-bend line loss of 1.25. Every track still ends mostly off track, so the robot leaves the tape at about 0.063 to 0.065 m. The floor is set by max(0.06, tape_half_width + body_width/4). At body_width 0.12 m that is 0.06 m, and body width cannot raise it in range. Sensor span, footprint and look-ahead changes (iterations 1 and 3) lowered the score, and the track-width trend from 0.12 to 0.09 m has flattened on the s-bend (0.0703, 0.0626, 0.0630, 0.0643 m across iterations 4 to 7). Narrowing to 0.08 m would add about 12 percent more yaw gain per command, which the oval oscillation already shows is at its limit. I therefore hold every geometry value at iteration 7's settings. This keeps the 213 platform fixed while the Integrator tunes the controller to bring oval oscillation below 0.25. I expect the score to hold at or above 213 with the oval oscillation falling and the s-bend max_error remaining near 0.063 m. If the score drops, the cause is the controller, because the geometry is held.
